title: 🎄 Historic Downtown Clarksville’s 1st Annual Cookie & Cocoa Crawl 🍪☕
description:
Get ready for a sweet holiday adventure in Historic Downtown Clarksville, Virginia! Bring the family and enjoy a festive day filled with holiday cheer, featuring Santa Claus, carolers, and life-sized gingerbread people!
🎟️ TICKETS REQUIRED — $40 PER TICKET — LIMITED AVAILABILITY!This is a ticketed event, and only a limited number of tickets are available. Purchase yours early to reserve your spot!
Your $40 ticket includes a cookie pail to fill with delicious cookies as you stroll through participating downtown businesses. Visit each designated stop to collect a cookie and fill your pail with holiday treats. Then, head to Cottage Barn for a cozy cup of cocoa!
While you’re downtown, explore our charming local shops and restaurants, where you’ll find special holiday offers, food and drink specials, and unique shopping opportunities.
Enjoy a wonderful holiday outing while supporting the local businesses that make Historic Downtown Clarksville such a special place. Your participation also helps support downtown revitalization efforts, including façade grants, wayfinding, beautification, and more.
🎁 A SPECIAL THANK-YOU TO QUACK THE CODE!A heartfelt thank-you to Quack the Code for sponsoring the cookie pails and helping make this sweet holiday experience possible!
🎄 Purchase your tickets below and join the crawl! With limited tickets available, don’t wait to claim your spot at this exciting new holiday tradition.One town, lots of cookies, a cup of cocoa, and plenty of Christmas magic!
📅 Date: Saturday, December 5, 2026🕙 Event Hours: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM🕐 Check-In: 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM📍 Location: Historic Downtown Clarksville, Virginia Check-In: Town Hall, 321 Virginia Avenue, Clarksville, VA 23927🚗 Parking: Available along Virginia Avenue and in the Third Street and Fourth Street parking lots.
